title: Musk says: Grok 4.6 will be released next week, and all of SpaceX's historical data will be fed into the model training

content_html:
On August 4th local time, Elon Musk, CEO of SpaceX, revealed AI advancements during the company's first earnings call and provided a clear timeline: Grok 4.6 is expected to be released next week, followed by Grok 4.7 in the coming weeks. Just a month ago, xAI launched Grok 4.5, which focuses on coding capabilities and can also handle financial and legal tasks.

The more critical step lies in the data sources. Musk revealed that SpaceX will provide fuel for Grok's training - "We will integrate the entire SpaceX dataset, basically all the data generated by SpaceX since its inception, into Grok's training." This means that the massive amount of first-hand data accumulated from rocket launches, spacecraft telemetry, manufacturing, and operations will be directly fed into the next generation of models, so Grok's next leap will no longer rely only on publicly available text, but will connect to the company's full set of private data.

content_html_zh:
当地时间 8 月 4 日，SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克在公司首次财报电话会议上透露了人工智能的进展，并提供了明确的时间表：预计下周发布 Grok 4.6，接下来几周发布 Grok 4.7。 就在一个月前，xAI推出了Grok 4.5，主打编码能力，还可以处理财务和法律任务。

更关键的一步在于数据源。 马斯克透露，SpaceX将为Grok的训练提供燃料——“我们将把整个SpaceX数据集，基本上是SpaceX自成立以来产生的所有数据，整合到Grok的训练中。” 这意味着从火箭发射、航天器遥测、制造和运营中积累的海量第一手数据将直接输入到下一代模型中，因此Grok的下一次飞跃将不再仅仅依赖于公开的文本，而是将连接到该公司的全套私人数据。
